questions.stem: How does auxin affect plant shoots and roots differently?

options.text: Auxin promotes growth in both shoots and roots equally
High concentrations of auxin promote growth in shoots but inhibit growth in roots
Auxin has no effect on roots, only on shoots
Auxin inhibits growth in both shoots and roots

questions.explanation: Auxin has opposite effects at high concentrations: it stimulates cell elongation in shoots (promoting growth) but inhibits cell elongation in roots. This is why shoots grow towards light while roots grow downwards.
